title: Moment-Video: Diagnosing Temporal Fidelity of Video MLLMs on Momentary Visual Events
abstract: arXiv:2606.02522v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in general and long-form video understanding, yet their ability to capture and use brief, answer-critical visual evidence remains underexplored. Momentary actions or state transitions may determine an answer while occupying only a small fraction of the video. Performance on broad video understanding tasks alone does not establish whether models can reliably identify and use this temporally localized evidence. We introduce Moment-Video, a benchmark for evaluating temporal fidelity through momentary visual event understanding. Questions are constructed around visually observable events or event sequences, requiring models to notice, count, describe, or reason about transient evidence. The benchmark contains 1,000 human-verified video-QA pairs across seven domains and 25 subcategories, covering four tasks: Temporal Occurrence, Temporal Counting, Action Descrip

translated_title: Moment-Video：诊断视频多模态大语言模型在瞬时视觉事件上的时间保真度
translated_abstract: 视频多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在通用视频理解和长视频理解方面取得了快速进展，但它们捕获并利用简短的、对答案起决定作用的视觉证据的能力仍缺乏充分研究。瞬时发生的动作或状态转变可能只占视频的一小部分，却可能直接决定答案。仅凭模型在宽泛视频理解任务上的表现，并不能说明模型能否可靠地识别并利用这种时间上局部化的证据。我们提出了Moment-Video，一个通过瞬时视觉事件理解来评估时间保真度的基准。问题围绕视觉上可观察的事件或事件序列构建，要求模型注意、计数、描述或推理瞬态证据。该基准包含1,000个经人工验证的视频问答对，覆盖七个领域和25个子类别，涉及四类任务：时间发生、时间计数、动作描述……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Moment-Video基准，通过涵盖七大门类、1,000个人工验证的视频问答对，系统评估视频多模态大语言模型在瞬时视觉事件理解上的时间保真度。
en_tdlr: We introduce Moment-Video, a benchmark of 1,000 human-verified video-QA pairs across seven domains for evaluating the temporal fidelity of video MLLMs in understanding momentary visual events.
